react.nativeToolingJustification: Vite tooling only: esbuild/rollup platform helpers generated in WebContainer, never copied from host. All lifecycle scripts disabled, no arbitrary native addons; exact Node/npm/platform/API compatibility and actual Vite execution required. No cross-engine portability assumption.
